label: Product Price
purpose: Display the product's price, compare-at price, and an optional promotional badge
_notes: custom_badge_text only renders when displayed_badge is 'custom' (it's ignored for 'sale' and 'none'); it supports dynamic placeholders [icon_1], [icon_2], [percentage] (percent saved vs compare price), and [amount] (money saved). icon_1/icon_2 are Material Symbols icon names shown inside the custom badge; custom_icon_1/custom_icon_2 optionally override them with an uploaded image (leave blank, filled by a separate image step). price_color, compare_price_color, all three price font-size ranges, sale_badge_color, icon_scale, filled_icon_1/2, and margins are pure visual styling and are intentionally excluded.
